key_findings: Nav1.7 and Nav1.8 form TrkB-facilitated polygonal-lattice supramolecular complexes (SMACs) in DRG neurons of SNI/diabetic mice and patients with severe neuropathic pain.
Combined Nav1.7 and Nav1.8 blockers act synergistically, and knockdown of five cytoskeletal proteins (SPTAN1, DSP, AHNAK, MPZ, PRX) disrupts SMACs and relieves pain in SNI mice.
